topPositive.text:
Thank you Hon AB, Governor of East Sepik for the wise counsel to our Sepik River people, East Sepik and the National Government including concerned Authorities. 
Our people of Sepik River has been living there along the River for hundreds of years from Ambunti down to Pagwi..Gawi people, down to Angoram, Marianberg, all the way to Kopar..
Maus blo Sepik including the Wewak Islands and the Manam Island  their lively hoods has been dependant on the Mighty Sepik River for generations.
Environmental Impact Studies and all other safety issues eminating from the Frieda Mining development MUST be addressed before mining activities take place. Our livelyhood will be affected and devastated as River people and Inland Sepik people have been dependent on fish, sago and local barter systems trade, living a carefree life as long as the Sepik River is our mother who feeds the inhabitants.
I am from Wosera and l stand with my Gaindus from Ambunti to Pagwi to Angoram to Kopar, l SAY NO FRIEDA MINING..
I CRY😂😂 FOR MY SEPIK RIVER TO BE FREE FROM MINING WASTE CONTAMINANTS.
LIVE MY SEPIK RIVER ALONE..❤❤
topPositive.author: @cainetommy4195
